name: Modern Day Prophets
overview: Scripture clearly warns that true prophets speak only the words God commands, and those who claim to prophesy without His mandate are false and face judgment, as seen in Deuteronomy 18:20 and Jeremiah 14:14. God reveals His plans to His servants, the prophets, according to Amos 3:7, yet believers must remain vigilant against false prophets who disguise their intentions, as Jesus cautions in Matthew 7:15. The prophetic office served a foundational role until John the Baptist, marking the transition to the preaching of the kingdom of God in Luke 16:16.
